external_components.role: SHA-256 primitive used by independently structured DP6 domain hashing

independence_statement: The verifier does not include or link the FAE HLS DP6 implementation.
Argon2 memory construction comes from the public PHC reference implementation.
RW5 and DP6 composition are independently structured C++ code using standard arithmetic and OpenSSL SHA-256.
The verifier is candidate assurance evidence, not a consensus implementation.
